# keeltrading.com

> The public website of keel — the open-source, auditable Shariah-compliance
> engine for spot crypto trading, by CodeGate Software.

keel enforces rulings you supply: attested screening that fails closed,
eighteen un-overridable execution rails, promotion gates with an overfitting
check, and honest DCA-benchmarked measurement. It is not a fatwa engine and
never derives a Shariah classification from market data; no scholarly review
of its fiqh basis has occurred. The site states its own honest result first:
no shipped rule family is net-positive at the taker fee actually paid on
Coinbase. Not financial advice; not a fatwa; attestation is the operator's
responsibility.

## Facts

- Engine: https://github.com/CodeGateSoftware/keel (Apache-2.0)
- Site source: https://github.com/CodeGateSoftware/keeltrading.com (code MIT, content © CodeGate Software)
- Editions: English (/en/) and Arabic (/ar/, RTL); French and Spanish reserved
- Docs on this site are fetched from the engine repository at build time and
  are shown in their original English
- Downloads link directly to GitHub Releases; binaries are never mirrored
- Not affiliated with the Kubernetes project Keel (keel.sh) or Keel
  Infrastructure (Nasdaq: KEEL); not affiliated with any exchange
